aboutView.heroTitle: Focused practice for writers who want to improve on purpose
aboutView.heroBody: Writing Coach gives you one assignment, a few clear craft goals, and feedback you can use right away. It is designed to help you build skill over time, not just produce one lucky draft.
aboutView.skillsBody1: Writing is broken into small, teachable skills. A skill might be causal clarity, scene architecture, or prose precision. You do not work on everything at once.
aboutView.skillsBody2: Each assignment focuses on just a few skills. Those become the goals for that piece. The review then checks the draft mainly against those goals, so the feedback stays specific.
aboutView.skillsBody3: When you show the same skill consistently, it moves toward mastery. Then the coach can unlock the next challenge. That keeps the work focused and makes progress easier to see.
aboutView.whatYouGet1: Assignments built around the skills you need most right now.
aboutView.whatYouGet2: Feedback tied to clear goals instead of vague general advice.
aboutView.whatYouGet3: Revision briefs when a draft deserves another pass.
aboutView.whatYouGet4: A progress view that shows where your control is improving.
aboutView.whatYouGet5: A visible path to the next skill, not just the next prompt.
aboutView.focusTitle: You practice one thing at a time
aboutView.focusBody: Most writers get overloaded when every draft is judged on everything. Writing Coach narrows the target. That makes it easier to see what changed and easier to repeat the improvement in later work.
aboutView.feedbackTitle: The feedback is meant to be usable
aboutView.feedbackBody: The goal is not to sound clever. The goal is to help you revise. Reviews point to a few strengths to keep, a few weaknesses to fix, and the next place to put your attention.
aboutView.progressBody: Old assignments, drafts, reviews, and revisions stay connected. That history helps the coach see what is improving, what keeps slipping, and what to assign next.
aboutView.differentCard1Title: It is more than a prompt generator
aboutView.differentCard1Body: The assignment matters, but the real value is the training structure behind it. The coach remembers what was practiced, what improved, and what still needs work.
aboutView.differentCard2Body: Each review is tied to the goals of that assignment. Later, you can look back at older work and still see what it trained. Your history stays useful.
aboutView.howItWorksTitle: A guided review, not just a chatbot answer
aboutView.howItWorksBody1: Writing Coach does not simply send your draft to a language model and accept whatever comes back. It starts with concrete checks for things like grammar problems, style issues, sentence strain, and repeated patterns. Tools such as LanguageTool, Vale, and the app's own sentence-analysis checks help build that first layer.
aboutView.howItWorksBody2: After that, the coach checks your active skills. These are the few craft goals your assignment is meant to train right now. Instead of trying to judge every part of the draft at once, the review stays focused on those goals.
aboutView.howItWorksBody3: When a language model is enabled, it comes in after those checks. The model helps write the assignment, shape the coaching language, and turn the raw signals into feedback that reads more like a teacher. It is working from structure and evidence, not guessing from scratch.
aboutView.howItWorksBody4: Over time, the app compares reviews, tracks which skills are improving, watches for old weaknesses coming back, and decides what to practice next. That is how it aims to build repeatable skill, not just produce one interesting comment on one draft.
aboutView.step1Body: The system scans for concrete issues it can measure reliably.
aboutView.step2Body: The coach matches those signals to the few skills that matter on this assignment.
aboutView.step3Body: The review, revision brief, and next assignment are built from that evidence.
